title: Retro Retreat
description:
The Retro Retreat is the upstairs apartment in a  historic property. 15 minutes from BNA & Opryland attractions and 15 minutes from downtown Nash, this cozy Inglewood apartment is wrapped in pine wood and furnished with a vintage flair with a private entrance.  The bedroom accommodates 2 guests, queen size bed.  Alternate foldable memory foam mattress is available. It is stored else ware, let me know before you arrive if it's needed. Off-street parking, two vehicles,  Daily coffee provided.

The space
The apartment has a full kitchen, a large living room with XX” TV and a desk with an outlet and phone charger; the unit has fast wifi. A nook offers seating for two people to enjoy a cocktail or write a song together.  The bedroom accommodates up to 2 guests with queen size bed. There are Lava Lamps in windows and they are on timers. They come on late afternoon and go off @ midnight. There are special instructions for the oven door because it doesn't close fully. It's old but works great.

Guest access
There is off-street parking for 3 vehicles, behind the garage. There are security cameras operating around the clock monitoring parking in front and behind garage.

Other things to note
There are no parties permitted in the unit. Your host lives in a separate building onsite and there are tenants in the main house area downstairs. You may see the occasional Lady Bug around the windows checking you out. Smoking is permitted outside on the porch. Small ashtray is provided there so no butts on the ground. There is a patio heater for smokers to use. Turn it off before going back upstairs. There is free coffee in the apt. It's a whole bean grinder coffee maker. I have it set up and ready to go for you with a second  set up for the following day in the mailbox at your door. Bring yesterdays coffee basket and hopper to mailbox to exchange for a vacuum sealed replacement each day.
Please know that we do not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion/creed, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital status, or military status. All are welcomed and tolerance is appreciated.
